description: Free. The last hour's pump.fun events as they land, oldest first: launches (with the deployer, the first 10 seconds' buys as a share of the supply, and the deployer's own buys and sells so far), graduations, migrations to PumpSwap, and dev sells (the wallet that launched a coin selling it, with the share of its bag sold). For: did the dev sell, which devs are dumping right now, what just launched or migrated. Poll with since = next_since.

since.description: unix seconds in the last hour; events from it on. Left out: the last ten minutes

name: live_events
